gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate, and the source HL7 specimen value set has no codes; general culture and nucleic-acid test alternatives requiring a separate sterile-site specimen criterion are omitted from IHID-R2, IHID-R3, and IHID-R10, while sterile-site-specific test-name alternatives remain modeled

SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate, and the source HL7 CSF value set has no codes; the general Hib antigen test alternative requiring a separate CSF criterion is omitted from IHID-R4, IHID-R6, and IHID-R10, while the CSF-specific antigen test-name alternative remains modeled
